subject: info-af-b
title: INFO.AF.B.------CR.INFO.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 179 (SR(TRS)II-35). INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; CR-INFO-DY (circular information dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: C-CONT (composite continuance) and CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). From CR-INFO-DY: CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts) and CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From CRTF-D: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and STF (source transfer). From STF: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: COS-D (cosmic dictates). From COS-D: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: LANG-DY (language dynamics).
